sports.title: Sports Photography
sports.description: Dynamic sports action capturing the intensity, passion, and decisive moments of athletic competition. From team spirit to individual triumph, these images freeze the power and grace of athletes in motion.

portrait.title: Portrait
portrait.description: Authentic portraits that reveal character, emotion, and personality. Whether in studio or natural settings, each image captures the unique essence and story of the individual.

still-photo.title: Still Photos
still-photo.description: Carefully crafted still photos and product photography showcasing attention to detail, refined lighting, and artistic composition. From commercial work to creative studies exploring form and texture.

design.title: Design
design.description: Architectural and design photography celebrating lines, patterns, and spaces. Capturing the intersection of form and function in modern and contemporary environments.

landscape.title: Landscape
landscape.description: Exploring the beauty and grandeur of natural and urban landscapes, from sweeping vistas to intimate environmental details.
